thread:
sam: Heads-up — we started getting a wave of 504s from hosted inference in eu-west-1 around 08:12 UTC. Several customers raised support tickets.

maria: seeing the same. Gateway logs show upstream timeouts to the model pool (504) and long tail latency on the inference queue.

jordan: quick snapshot from the autoscaler metrics: external queue-length metric spiked to ~1.2k, but HPA/KEDA didn't scale fast enough. KEDA shows scaler status 'Inactive' for the model-pool scaledobject.

emily-cs: customer repro: single request with ~800 tokens, followed by a burst of small concurrent requests. They hit 30s client timeouts.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: new rollout for inference-runtime v2.6.1 finished at 07:58 UTC (no errors reported). :white_check_mark:

sam: could be a warm-start regression in v2.6.1 — model init path may be slower and readiness gating is preventing pod capacity before traffic arrives.

maria: i pulled the scaledobject and scaledown config. Note: scaledobject references external metric name "inference-queue-length-v1" but the metrics adapter is emitting "inference.queue.length" (dot vs dash). looks like a naming mismatch — KEDA never activated.

jordan: logs from model-pool pods during scale events:
```
2026-03-17T08:13:01Z model-init: pulling model weights (quantized)
2026-03-17T08:13:12Z kv-cache warmup start
2026-03-17T08:13:40Z readiness-probe: not ready, warmup_inflight=5
2026-03-17T08:14:05Z grpc: accept connection but model not ready -> upstream timeout
```

emily-cs: customer also reports auth retries around the same time — some 401->429 flapping in the front-door logs. but primary impact is 504.

oncall-sre: immediate mitigation suggestions?

sam: mitigation applied: bumped minReplicas for model-pool to 4 (was 1) for eu-west-1; patched HPA to use the external metric name emitted by adapter as a stop-gap. Patching now:
```
kubectl patch scaledobject model-pool-so -n inference --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/triggers/0/metadata/metricName","value":"inference.queue.length"}]'
```

jordan: also temporarily reduced readiness probe initialDelaySeconds from 30 -> 5 for the model-pool to allow faster acceptance of traffic during the patch window. we'll revert after root cause.

maria: follow-up: need to write a durable migration for metric name change — either adapter emits backward-compatible names or scaledobjects are updated during deploys. Add validation in CI.

emily-cs: repro steps captured for support ticket:
1) send a large streaming request (~700-900 tokens) to the hosted API
2) concurrently fire 50 short requests within 10s
3) observe client 30s timeout and 504s in gateway logs

oncall-sre: logs for the gateway:
```
2026-03-17T08:12:55Z gateway: received request id=abc123
2026-03-17T08:13:28Z gateway: upstream write timeout to 10.0.12.45:8080
2026-03-17T08:13:28Z gateway: returning 504 to client id=abc123
```

sam: next actions:
- root cause RCA: metric naming regression due to metrics adapter change in v2.6.1 (maria to own)
- infra change: add fallback metric mapping in KEDA operator config (jordan)
- runtime change: instrument and shorten model warm-start path + ensure readiness toggles sooner (research + eng-runtime)
- product: notify affected customers and offer priority credits (emily-cs)

maria: i'll open a PR to update the adapter to emit both names and add a CI check against scaledobject references.

jordan: i'll follow up with a small playbook for SRE: quick patch commands, metric checks, and rollback steps for v2.6.1.

oncall-sre: assigning page to jordan and maria for RCA. escalation ticket created: INC-2026-327.

emily-cs: customer comms drafted, will wait for confirmation of mitigation stability. :thumbsup:

sam: monitoring — queue length returned to baseline after minReplicas bump and metric patch. keeping this thread open until RCA is merged.

maria: noted. saving logs and traces to the incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/2026/03/17/3476543210.zip

jordan: postmortem will include timeline, code pointers, CI checks, and mitigations. ETA for draft: EOD 2026-03-18.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-327 status updated -> mitigated (temporary fixes applied).
